info.title: Human Agent
info.description: Read-only world v0.12 analysis, never a world step API.

core_original_human.summary: Core 原始請求：無計畫、存活未知

content.question: 請評估四人的個人補給需求及公共水、氧氣、電與食物；沒有計畫時不要自動安排工作。

crew.death: personal energy or water <= 0; any crew death ends mission

irrigation.priority: Core supplied order; omitted living plots receive nothing
irrigation.failure: no input deducted, no growth or oxygen; success resets misses
irrigation.dead: no consumption or yield; clear before planting

tasks.occupancy: eat, drink, generate, plant, harvest, clear: one crew per tick
tasks.crop_actions: at tick end, ordered; no premature harvest; full storage blocks harvest
tasks.plant: empty plot only; no seed cost; starts growing next tick

rules.oxygen_death: public oxygen <= 0 immediately kills all crew, even before plants produce oxygen
rules.planning: world paused while planning; validate state version before apply; no simulator
rules.completion: no stable/success threshold; continue until death

content.unit_conversion_policy: Core傳送世界原始數值與單位，不轉換文獻單位。專家自行完成文獻與世界單位、時間基準的換算；回覆可執行建議須使用世界單位，並在evidence_and_unknowns說明換算依據或缺少的映射。不得自行假設EU對Wh的比例。電力及跨角色資源分配由Core決定。
content.response_guidance: 請在外層 display_text 提供2至4句繁體中文對話：觀察、建議、取捨或不確定性。這是公開理由摘要，不是內部思考鏈；不得聲稱操作已執行。另須提供explanation結構：觀察、各項建議策略／理由／效果／代價／依據、回覆其他建議的評估與不確定性。
